safety_verdicts.content: Patient reports a tingling sensation around the lips.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold specifies tingling around the lips; generated notes tingling in the left ear but does not mention lip tingling.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Perioral tingling can be an early neurologic/mucosal symptom associated with evolving allergic reactions/anaphylaxis and helps convey acuity. Omitting it could lead to underestimation of severity or less urgent triage/monitoring in a high-risk presentation with breathing complaints.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: No penicillin allergy is included in generated facts.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Missing a penicillin allergy can directly lead to prescribing an allergenic antibiotic, potentially causing an allergic reaction including anaphylaxis. Even if not immediately relevant in this encounter, it is a high-risk omission for future treatment decisions.
